annotationRationale: The class sizes supply the weights for combining the two means. The supplied approaches are equivalent weighted-mean calculations, so one complete method is sufficient.

classificationReview.areaCheck: Prealgebra is a reasonable broad classification for this elementary weighted-mean calculation. No obvious subject repair is required.

review.questionCheck: With class sizes 3k and 4k, the combined mean is (84·3k+70·4k)/(7k)=532/7=76. Choice C and the key agree. The stem is unambiguous and requires no figure.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: 2021_AMC_10B_Q06/combine-class-score-totals is retained for the identical question. LIVE and AoPS Solutions 1 through 4 use equivalent weighted-mean calculations and are merged into this complete route. Their changes of variables or normalized weights do not warrant additional methods.
review.annotationCheck: Assessed cnm_212 precisely matches identifying class sizes as weights and computing the combined mean. No additional support or contextual node is necessary.
review.areaCheck: Prealgebra is a reasonable broad classification for this elementary weighted-mean calculation. No obvious subject repair is required.

methodReviews.mathCheck: The ratio permits class sizes 3k and 4k with k>0. Their score totals are 252k and 280k, so dividing their sum by 7k gives exactly 76. Cancellation of k is valid.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: Correctly reuses amc/2021_AMC_10B_Q06#combine-class-score-totals. The shared reference and both inherited ids, live-reference-2021_AMC_10B_Q06 and aops-reference-2021_AMC_10B_Q06, are retained, together with the current-question references. The project adaptation is properly source-informed-original.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The explanation derives the weighted mean from score totals instead of assuming a formula. It explains the role of the class-size ratio and accounts for the combined student count.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: cnm_212 is the central exact concept: the student counts provide the weights, and the solution explains their effect.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The exact 加权平均数 link fits both identifying the weights and computing with them.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: No accepted US link is supplied for cnm_212. This is an honest alignment gap and does not invalidate the method.
nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: cnm_212 accurately and sufficiently captures the derivation.
